responsibility: This file lowers D frontend statements and function bodies to GCC tree statement form. It manages lexical binding levels and label-scope legality for gotos, builds and flattens statement lists, and via its main IR visitor translates D statements—including control flow, exception handling scaffolding, imports, and GCC-style inline asm statements—into backend trees while preserving D scoping and cleanup semantics. It is the statement-level counterpart to `expr.cc` and the main body-builder used by function code generation.
